heading.purpose: Page titles, card titles, section headers.

body.purpose: Default text — document content, timeline cards, form values.

label.purpose: Metadata lines, badge text, form field labels.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Rarely used — most cards use the ring-1 hairline instead.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and popovers hovering above content.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Full sheets and modals that detach from the page.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals and state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen — Trust Teal fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.44 0.11 183); color: oklch(0.98 0.01 183); border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0 10px; height: 2rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.44 0.11 183 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.44 0.11 183 / 0.5); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Delete document — soft destructive tint, not a solid red fill, per the No-Severity Rule extended to the interface's own actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0 10px; height: 2rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); }

components.name: Organizing Badge
components.description: Pipeline-state badge — AI is currently processing this document. AI Indigo is reserved exclusively for this meaning.
components.css: .ds-badge-organizing { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.94 0.04 258); color: oklch(0.52 0.10 258); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Organized Badge
components.description: Pipeline-state badge — organize succeeded. Success Green means pipeline success, never medical good news.
components.css: .ds-badge-organized { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.94 0.04 155); color: oklch(0.52 0.13 155); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface with a hairline ring instead of a shadow — the default container for timeline cards and document detail sections.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(1 0 0); border-radius: 1.05rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.13 0.01 250 / 0.1); padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(0.13 0.01 250); } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.52 0.008 250); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field — transparent background, hairline border, teal focus ring matching the button focus language.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 0.6rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.006 90); background: transparent; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.13 0.01 250); outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.52 0.008 250); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.44 0.11 183); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.44 0.11 183 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview:
CareAlign is what a trusted family folder feels like translated to screen: quiet, unhurried, and never alarming, because the moment it exists for -- a doctor asking "what happened last time" -- is already stressful enough without the software adding to it. The system rejects both extremes of health software: it is not a clinical chart bristling with red flags and severity indicators, and it is not a consumer wellness app performing positivity with gradients and mascots. It sits in between, closer to a well-organized paper folder than either.

This restraint is not just aesthetic -- it is the product's safety boundary made visible. CareAlign explains what a document says; it never advises, assesses severity, or implies urgency. A lab value flagged "HIGH" on the source document is shown in the same plain text as everything else, because rendering it in red or with a warning icon would be the interface making a clinical judgment the product is contractually forbidden from making. Every visual decision here either serves legibility for a family under time pressure, or gets left out.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color: one identity hue (teal) plus narrow-purpose functional colors (warm highlight, AI-processing indigo, success green) — never decoration.
Flat-by-default surfaces (a hairline ring, not a shadow) with elevation reserved for things that are genuinely floating (dialogs, sheets).
One typeface family carrying every role — headings, labels, body, data — because a health record is read, not admired.
No color is ever used to imply clinical severity. Status colors describe pipeline state (is this document organized yet?), never medical state.

rules.name: The No-Severity Rule
rules.body: Color is never used to signal how alarming a medical value is. A lab flag reads "HIGH" in plain ink text with a caption explaining it was copied verbatim, never rendered in red, bold-and-red, or with a warning triangle. Explaining is not advising, and color is advice's easiest disguise.

rules.name: The One-Job Rule
rules.body: Success Green means "this pipeline step succeeded," not "this is good news medically." AI Indigo means "the model is running," never decoration.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: No fluid/clamp() type sizing anywhere. This is product UI viewed at a consistent DPI, not a marketing page.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A card sitting in normal document flow gets a ring-1 hairline, never a shadow. Shadows are earned only by things that detach from the page (sheets, dialogs, dropdowns).

dos: Do keep every lab flag, test result, and clinical value in plain ink text — color communicates pipeline state, never medical severity.
Do use the ring-hairline for any card or surface sitting in normal document flow; reserve shadows for things that detach from the page.
Do use Trust Teal for exactly one primary action per screen.
Do show skeleton states ("Organizing…" cards) for loading, never a bare spinner mid-content.
donts: Don't use red, orange, or a warning icon to render a flagged lab value or an out-of-range result.
Don't introduce a second saturated color competing with Trust Teal for attention on one screen.
Don't use AI Indigo or Success Green for anything other than pipeline/processing state.
Don't reach for a fluid/clamp() heading scale.
Don't default to a modal for anything that could be inline or progressive.
